title: Compare two PCB documents layer by layer
summary: Shows how to open two .PcbDoc files, get their boards with GetPCBBoardByPath and compare them with IPCB_PrimitiveComparator.Compare, including the caveat that identical copies can compare as false.
phrasings: find differences between two board revisions
get the board of a PcbDoc that is not the active document
use the primitive comparator on boards

commands.name: CompareBoard
commands.description: Compare two PCB documents layer by layer
commands.params: BoardA=<path to .PcbDoc>|BoardB=<path to .PcbDoc>|Tolerance=<square internal units, default 0>|Show=false (optional) (from the menu without parameters: file dialogs)
